hero.name: Kiosk Behavioural Games
hero.tagline: Touch-first games at a golden-hour village fair whose play becomes candidate indicators for 17 constructs, validated before anything reaches a player.
hero.label: Kiosk Behavioural Games: touch-first kiosk games whose play becomes candidate indicators for 17 constructs, validated before anything reaches a player

cards.label: What the system does: two pathways, voice-optional play, an encrypted offline outbox, a versioned scoring dictionary, a validation workbench and privacy by design

items.title: Two pathways, 15 minutes
items.body: Pathway A: three story episodes at the fair. Pathway B: a carousel of micro-games. Both end inside 900 s.

items.title: Touch always works
items.body: No reading, no keyboard. Voice is optional and closed-vocabulary, every prompt is mirrored by an icon.

items.title: Sealed at the kiosk
items.body: Events are encrypted per session in a SQLite outbox, sealed to the backend key and uploaded idempotently.

items.title: Science in YAML
items.body: Indicators, hypotheses and gates live in a versioned dictionary. Code never holds a threshold.

items.title: A validation workbench
items.body: Reliability, MTMM validity, invariance, DIF and norming in Python and R, on synthetic data until the pilot.

items.title: Fail closed, adults only
items.body: Consent by tap, no audio kept, no camera, crypto-shredding erasure. Reports stay off until the gates pass.

cards:games.label: The nine Pathway B micro-games: Balloon Pump, Don't-Tap, Card Sort, Tower, Share-the-Pot, Private Dice, Wait-or-Now, Steady Hands and Four Stalls

items.title: Balloon Pump
items.body: Pump to grow the jar, bank before it bursts. Risk preference and decisiveness.

items.title: Don't-Tap
items.body: Go/no-go with a pressure block. Self-control and composure.

items.title: Card Sort
items.body: An unannounced rule switch and a reversal. Adaptability.

items.title: Tower
items.body: Move pots between baskets, two puzzles unsolvable. Planning and persistence.

items.title: Share-the-Pot
items.body: Eight public-goods rounds with scripted partners. Teamwork.

items.title: Private Dice
items.body: A cupped-hand report, true roll never logged. Integrity at group level only.

items.title: Wait-or-Now
items.body: Sun-and-moon delays and hold-to-earn effort. Self-control and persistence.

items.title: Steady Hands
items.body: Free and held responding with distractors. Restraint and composure.

items.title: Four Stalls
items.body: Four vendors with seeded payoffs, repeated probes. Decisiveness and risk.

pipeline.label: How a session becomes evidence: play, seal, ingest, score, validate, report

stats.label: At a glance: 17 constructs, two pathways, a 15-minute session cap and five data layers that never mix

timeline.label: Build so far: plan and wave 1, wave 2, the live pilot, hardening, the t3.small host, then Stage 1 in the field
